text:
Priya: Partner asked for a single gating deliverable that covers H100/H200, MI300, B200 and a short non-binding Gaudi roadmap line. Need compatibility matrix, canary plan, SI runbook, and a short embargo handshake by end of week. Who can take the matrix?
Owen: Ill own the matrix and the embargo blurb. Will need perf confirmation and exact runtime tags. Can @Hector confirm test ETA?
Hector: Perf runs scheduled in staging rack: MI300 tomorrow 07:00 PST, H200 11:00 PST, H100 18:00 PST, B200 thermal pass 19:30 PST. Expect logs by EOD. B200 will likely show power-capped deltas; we should add a separate B200 power/thermal row.
Lea: SI team available Fri-Sat for dry-run. Please post image tags and minimal partner runbook so they can validate in their lab.
Owen: Staging tags (provisional):
```
redwood/runtime:1.2.0-mi300-rc
redwood/runtime:1.2.0-h200-rc
redwood/runtime:1.2.0-h100-rc
redwood/runtime:1.2.0-b200-rc
redwood/runtime:1.2.0-gaudi-community-rc
kernel: 5.15.128 + nvidia-545-rc
```
Priya: Include a Gaudi roadmap row labeled "community-verified; full cert post-GA". Keep wording non-committal. Partner asked for it to be visible.
Owen: Draft embargo handshake (short):
- Share matrix with partner: t0
- Partner review window: 96h after t0
- Final signoff: 48h after partner ack (require email or Jira ticket)
- Canary validation: 24-48h after signoff (dedicated pool first)
Fallback: If compatibility or firmware blocks, delay public listing and issue partner-facing hotfix plan + docs.
Lea: Canary routing plan: start in Dedicated/us-west-2 (3% traffic) -> broad canary Dedicated/us-east-1 (25%) -> then GA. Exclude Hosted for the first 48h. Add auto-fallback to Private clusters if Dedicated capacity is constrained.
Hector: Runbook one-liner for partners: `docker pull redwood/runtime:1.2.0-mi300-rc && sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime && ./tools/check_gpu_health.sh --quick`
Lea: SI escalation snippet to include in matrix: "If ECC/memory errors -> page runtime-oncall and open Jira RED-9001. If firmware mismatch -> pause canary and escalate to drivers lead."
Owen: Partner requested sample logs (PII-scrubbed). I'll create a trimmed sample and attach to the matrix doc.
Priya: Ops-bot, please create an internal calendar block for the partner handshake review: Fri 10:00 PST.
ops-bot: Created event "HW Marketplace Gating Review: H100/H200/MI300/B200" Fri 10:00-11:00 PST, invited: Priya, Owen, Lea, Hector.
Hector: Uploading perf logs to gs://redwood-staging/gpu-gating/3876543210/ when tests finish. I'll also paste driver/git hashes into the matrix.
Lea: Add a B200 note column: "power/thermal profile; may require 20% headroom on thermal capping for stable throughput". Partner insisted on the explicit caveat.
Owen: Action items recap: Owen -> matrix + embargo blurb (owner) due Thu EOD. Hector -> perf logs + driver hashes (owner) expected Thu night. Lea -> SI schedule + runbook + escalation (owner) Fri morning. Priya -> partner comms and Gaudi roadmap line.
Priya: Keep partner-facing wording tight. No dates in the Gaudi row, just "targeting future cert; community image smoke-verified".
Owen: I'll post the matrix link here when it's ready (view/edit for owners).
Hector: Noted. Logs will be uploaded and I will link them here.
Lea: SI invites to partner contacts will go out after Owen posts the matrix.
Priya: Thanks team. If anything slips, we abort public announce until partner signoff or we have an agreed hotfix plan. :no_entry_sign:
Owen: Thanks all :thumbsup:
